retrievalProfile.description: A mystical cosmic composition featuring a central glowing energy orb held by a hand, set against a faint ethereal portrait and radial light bursts.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric scene dominated by deep purples and blacks. A central glowing orb emits sharp, radial beams of light and electrical arcs. Behind the orb, a large, translucent airbrushed face gazes forward from a starry, cloudy background. Hand-drawn, stylized lettering is positioned at the top and bottom edges, with a graffiti-style logo layered directly over the central orb.
coreVisualRelationships: Central orb as the primary light source and focal point
Radial beams creating a sense of explosive energy
Layered transparency between the face and the cosmic background
Symmetrical framing of text at top and bottom margins
coreInvariants: Deep purple and indigo color palette
Radial composition centered on the lower-middle third
Airbrushed texture with soft gradients and sharp highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central energy orb held by a hand occupies the lower-middle; a large-scale ethereal face fills the upper two-thirds of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing purple and white orb at the center of the radial light rays.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central orb, follow the radial rays outward, then move upward to the face and top text, finally settling on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep space clouds and starry voids provide dark contrast for the bright light effects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark, desaturated background elements and high-value, saturated light effects.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a fluid, calligraphic script with elongated ascenders and descenders
Central logo uses aggressive, interlocking graffiti-style block letters with drips
Bottom text uses a casual, hand-written cursive with varying baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the central logo are distorted to fit within the circular energy field
Script terminals are sharp and flame-like
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between elegant celestial script and aggressive urban graffiti.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, sharp-ended calligraphy of the top text.
Matches the interlocking, aggressive nature of the central logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed cosmic scene with a deep purple and black starry sky. In the center, a hand holds a glowing purple energy orb that emits sharp, radial white light beams and small electrical arcs. Behind the orb, a large, faint, translucent face is integrated into the space clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add gold calligraphic script along the top edge with a slight arc. Place a red and orange graffiti-style logo directly over the center of the energy orb. Add a line of casual gold cursive text along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the orb the brightest point?
Are the light rays perfectly radial?
Is the background face subtle and translucent?
Does the typography use the specified gold and red colors?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the radial light rays
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Exact graffiti letter shapes to ensure originality
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand holding the orb is anatomically integrated.
Check that the radial rays do not obscure the text legibility.
Verify the color balance between the purple background and gold text.
Confirm the 'glow' effect is consistent across all light sources.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cosmic Background] + [Airbrushed Portrait] + [Central Energy Source] + [Radial Light Effects] + [Graffiti/Script Typography Overlay].
